terms.plain_meaning: The Adaptive Emitter decided BUY on this accepted minute.
terms.scientific_meaning: decide() returns SideBuy when PathDirection is UPWARD, H==1, C >= prior-15 median C, and UpCount >= DownCount. Rule path UPWARD_AND_PRIOR_DIRECTION_AGREEMENT_AND_C_GE_PRIOR_MEDIAN. Sets scientific position LONG.
does_not_mean: BUY is not a Price Engine GREEN.
BUY is not an OMS or broker order.
BUY is not the same as scientific LONG by itself; LONG is the resulting emitter position state.
terms.interpretation: A scientific buy decision, not an order and not a Price Engine color.

ui.tooltip: Adaptive Emitter decision: BUY. Not an order.
ui.popover_body: The emitter decided BUY because the return-shape path is upward, D04 hard eligibility is 1, capturability is at least the prior-15 median, and recent path counts agree with up. This does not place an order and is not a Price Engine color.

terms.plain_meaning: The Adaptive Emitter decided SELL on this accepted minute.
terms.scientific_meaning: decide() returns SideSell when PathDirection is DOWNWARD, H==1, C >= prior-15 median C, and DownCount >= UpCount. Sets scientific position SHORT.
does_not_mean: SELL is not a Price Engine RED.
SELL is not a broker order.
terms.interpretation: A scientific sell decision, not an order and not Price Engine RED.

ui.tooltip: Adaptive Emitter decision: SELL. Not an order.
ui.popover_body: The emitter decided SELL under the downward path-agreement predicate. This is not an execution instruction and is independent of Price Engine color.

terms.plain_meaning: The Adaptive Emitter decided HOLD. Hold is a decision, not a skip.
terms.scientific_meaning: decide() returns SideHold when the BUY/SELL predicate is not satisfied (rule AFFIRM_POSITION_STATE_TRANSITION_PREDICATE_NOT_SATISFIED). Emitter position is left unchanged.
does_not_mean: HOLD is not the Price Engine airport status HOLDING.
HOLD is not Price Engine AMBER.
HOLD is not INITIALIZING and not a host-gate skip.
terms.interpretation: An evaluated decision to keep the current scientific position.

ui.tooltip: Adaptive decision HOLD. Not a skip, and not Price Engine HOLDING.
ui.popover_body: HOLD means the BUY/SELL transition predicate was not met. The scientific LONG/SHORT/FLAT position is unchanged. This is not the Arrivals-board word HOLDING, which is a viewer alias of Price Engine AMBER.

terms.plain_meaning: The emitter's scientific position is LONG after a BUY.
terms.scientific_meaning: EmitterPosition LONG. Set when Side is BUY (nextPosition = EmitterLong). Not an account position.
does_not_mean: This is not a brokerage long position.
This is not Price Engine UP.
terms.interpretation: Scientific LONG/SHORT/FLAT tracks emitter state, not ledger quantity.

ui.tooltip: Scientific emitter position LONG, not an account position.
ui.popover_body: After a BUY decision the emitter stores LONG. It is not P-05/P-08 position or inventory.

terms.plain_meaning: The emitter's scientific position is SHORT after a SELL.
terms.scientific_meaning: EmitterPosition SHORT. Set when Side is SELL. Not an account short.
does_not_mean: This is not a brokerage short.
This is not Price Engine DOWN.
terms.interpretation: The emitter's scientific position is SHORT after a SELL.

ui.tooltip: Scientific emitter position SHORT, not an account short.
ui.popover_body: After a SELL decision the emitter stores SHORT. Combined dashboard text such as Hold · scientific SHORT means HOLD decision plus leftover SHORT position.

terms.plain_meaning: The emitter has no LONG or SHORT scientific position.
terms.scientific_meaning: EmitterPosition FLAT. Initial engine state before any BUY/SELL.
terms.interpretation: The emitter has no LONG or SHORT scientific position.

ui.popover_body: FLAT is the emitter position before any BUY or SELL. It is a different enum from D02 path FLAT.

terms.plain_meaning: The elastic return shape's terminal displacement is positive.
terms.scientific_meaning: PathDirection UPWARD when TerminalDisplacement > 0 in ValidateReturnShape / BuildReturnShape.
does_not_mean: UPWARD is not Price Engine UP_ACCELERATING.
terms.interpretation: The elastic return shape's terminal displacement is positive.

ui.tooltip: D02 path is upward (positive terminal displacement).
ui.popover_body: D02 classifies path from the sign of terminal displacement. BUY still requires H, C, and prior-direction agreement.

terms.plain_meaning: The elastic return shape's terminal displacement is negative.
terms.scientific_meaning: PathDirection DOWNWARD when TerminalDisplacement < 0.
terms.interpretation: The elastic return shape's terminal displacement is negative.

ui.tooltip: D02 path is downward (negative terminal displacement).
ui.popover_body: Downward path is an input to the SELL predicate, not a SELL by itself.

terms.plain_meaning: Terminal displacement of the return shape is zero.
terms.scientific_meaning: PathDirection FLAT when TerminalDisplacement == 0.
terms.interpretation: Terminal displacement of the return shape is zero.

ui.tooltip: D02 path is flat (zero terminal displacement).
ui.popover_body: Path FLAT is a shape classification. Emitter FLAT is a position state. They share English but not identity.

terms.plain_meaning: The model is building its first 15 accepted eligible minutes. Not a failure.
terms.scientific_meaning: SkipInitializing when completedCount < ContextLength (15). ActionableAfter = 16. State is committed. ModelStatus INITIALIZING.
terms.interpretation: The model is building its first 15 accepted eligible minutes. Not a failure.

ui.popover_body: The first 15 accepted eligible minutes emit INITIALIZING skips with committed D01 state. The 16th can be BUY, SELL, or HOLD. Price Engine warm-up is independently 45 minutes.

terms.plain_meaning: Warm-up is complete. This minute can be BUY, SELL, or HOLD.
terms.scientific_meaning: ModelStatus ACTIONABLE on Decision after completedCount >= 15.
does_not_mean: ACTIONABLE is not an order permission.
ACTIONABLE is not Price Engine EMITTED.
terms.interpretation: Warm-up is complete. This minute can be BUY, SELL, or HOLD.

ui.tooltip: Adaptive is past warm-up and can emit BUY, SELL, or HOLD.
ui.popover_body: Actionable means the 15-bar context exists. It does not mean P-05 may submit an order.

terms.plain_meaning: Hard eligibility: 1 if the shape is timely and market-eligible, else 0.
terms.scientific_meaning: HardEligibility is 1 iff projectionValid (EvaluationTime <= ModelTime+ProjectionInterval) and MarketEligible is nil or true. C = H * Q_G * Q_S * Q_R.
terms.interpretation: Hard eligibility: 1 if the shape is timely and market-eligible, else 0.

ui.tooltip: D04 hard eligibility H is 0 or 1.
ui.popover_body: H is 1 when the projected shape is still timely. BUY/SELL also require C versus the prior-15 median and path agreement.

terms.plain_meaning: Geometry quality of the return shape.
terms.scientific_meaning: geometryQuality = |TerminalDisplacement| / MaximumAbsoluteDisplacement, or 0 if max displacement is 0.
does_not_mean: Q_G is not Price Engine GREEN.
terms.interpretation: Geometry quality of the return shape.

ui.popover_body: Q_G measures how much of the shape's maximum displacement is still present at the terminal sample.

terms.plain_meaning: Structural quality from strength, coherence, and persistence.
terms.scientific_meaning: structuralQuality = (strength * coherence * persistence) ** (1/3) using Pow, not Cbrt.
does_not_mean: Q_S is not Price Engine stability.
terms.interpretation: Structural quality from strength, coherence, and persistence.

ui.popover_body: Q_S is the geometric mean of strength, coherence, and persistence.

terms.plain_meaning: Risk quality from low uncertainty and low reversal propensity.
terms.scientific_meaning: riskQuality = sqrt((1-uncertainty) * (1-reversal_propensity)).
does_not_mean: Q_R is not a P-05 risk decision.
terms.interpretation: Risk quality from low uncertainty and low reversal propensity.

ui.popover_body: Q_R rises when uncertainty and reversal propensity are low. It is not OMS risk.

terms.plain_meaning: Capturability score on [0, 1].
terms.scientific_meaning: CapturabilityScore = H * Q_G * Q_S * Q_R. BUY/SELL require C >= prior-15 median C.
does_not_mean: High C is not automatically BUY.
C is not Price Engine confidence HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW.
terms.interpretation: Capturability score on [0, 1].

ui.tooltip: D04 capturability C = H × Q_G × Q_S × Q_R.
ui.popover_body: C is the capturability score. Price Engine confidence HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW is a different classification.

terms.plain_meaning: D01 channel strength carried onto the D02 shape.
terms.scientific_meaning: computeStrength(...) on D01; copied onto ReturnShape.Strength and Decision.Strength.
terms.interpretation: D01 channel strength carried onto the D02 shape.

ui.popover_body: Strength is a D01 evolving-state channel used in D04 Q_S.

terms.plain_meaning: D01 coherence among displacement, velocity, acceleration, and volume evidence.
terms.scientific_meaning: computeCoherence(evidence, ChannelWeights).
terms.interpretation: D01 coherence among displacement, velocity, acceleration, and volume evidence.

ui.popover_body: Coherence measures agreement among D01 evidence channels.

terms.plain_meaning: D01 persistence of the current motion regime.
terms.scientific_meaning: updatePersistence(...) on D01; not PriceCockpit.PersistenceState.
terms.interpretation: D01 persistence of the current motion regime.

ui.tooltip: D01 persistence of the motion regime.
ui.popover_body: Adaptive persistence is a D01 scalar. Price Engine cockpit persistence is a different string state.

terms.plain_meaning: D01 uncertainty used in D04 risk quality.
terms.scientific_meaning: computeUncertainty(...). If > 0.5, D04 reason UNCERTAINTY_HIGH.
terms.interpretation: D01 uncertainty used in D04 risk quality.

ui.popover_body: Higher uncertainty lowers D04 Q_R.

terms.plain_meaning: D01 reversal propensity used in D04 risk quality.
terms.scientific_meaning: computeReversalPropensity(...). If > 0.5, D04 reason REVERSAL_PROPENSITY_HIGH.
terms.interpretation: D01 reversal propensity used in D04 risk quality.

ui.popover_body: This is a D01 scalar. Price Engine turning phases are computed from p1/p2, not this field.

terms.plain_meaning: Inference is paused. Scientific state is held, not reset.
terms.scientific_meaning: Host.handle emits SkipInferOff when src.Readiness().Infer is false. PrepareStep is not called.
does_not_mean: Infer off does not reset D01 or pricing history.
terms.interpretation: Inference is paused. Scientific state is held, not reset.

ui.tooltip: Inference paused. State is held, not reset.
ui.popover_body: The host skipped this minute because the P-02 infer gate is false. Adaptive and pricing history stay as they were.

terms.plain_meaning: This bar is not a complete live finalized minute, so the model did not run.
terms.scientific_meaning: ModelEligible() requires IsFinal, QualityComplete, and !IsBackfilled.
does_not_mean: Not proof that the feed is down.
terms.interpretation: This bar is not a complete live finalized minute, so the model did not run.

ui.tooltip: Bar is not a complete live minute. Model did not run.
ui.popover_body: Only finalized COMPLETE non-backfilled bars enter Adaptive and Price Engine.

terms.plain_meaning: This minute was already accepted, or time went backwards. State was not advanced.
terms.scientific_meaning: ClassifyBarContinuity Duplicate or Regression, or EventTime did not increase. Host does not latch discontinuity.
does_not_mean: Not a skipped IEX minute (that is irregular, accepted).
terms.interpretation: This minute was already accepted, or time went backwards. State was not advanced.

ui.tooltip: Duplicate or earlier timestamp. State unchanged.
ui.popover_body: The host refused to step twice on the same or earlier IntervalStart.

terms.plain_meaning: Proven missing eligible observation. A skipped provider minute is not this.
terms.scientific_meaning: After the 2 Sep continuity fix, INPUT_GAP is reserved for proven missing eligible bars (test harness) or equivalent proven loss. A 10:31→10:34 IEX skip is ContinuityIrregular and is accepted. Historical viewer text that treated every non-adjacent minute as INPUT_GAP is stale.
does_not_mean: A missing IEX no-trade minute is not automatically INPUT_GAP.
Silence (no new bar) is not INPUT_GAP.
terms.interpretation: Proven missing eligible observation. A skipped provider minute is not this.

ui.tooltip: Proven observation loss. Not a normal skipped IEX minute.
ui.popover_body: INPUT_GAP now means the host has evidence a required eligible bar was lost. A provider-omitted minute is a valid irregular interval and does not pause the symbol.

terms.plain_meaning: The model mailbox could not accept the next bar without dropping. This symbol is quarantined.
terms.scientific_meaning: Host.dispatch default branch or model_path fanoutModel overflow sets SkipQueueOverflow and marks discontinuous. No silent drop-oldest.
does_not_mean: Other symbols are not automatically stopped.
terms.interpretation: The model mailbox could not accept the next bar without dropping. This symbol is quarantined.

ui.tooltip: Model mailbox overflow. This symbol is paused.
ui.popover_body: The host refused to silently drop an older bar. This symbol stays discontinuous until explicit reset or process restart.

terms.plain_meaning: The step exceeded the host deadline. State was not committed.
terms.scientific_meaning: QUANTRAM_MODEL_DEADLINE default 200ms. Timeout leaves committed adaptive/pricing state unchanged.
terms.interpretation: The step exceeded the host deadline. State was not committed.

ui.tooltip: Step exceeded the deadline. State unchanged.
ui.popover_body: Prepare/commit did not finish in time. The prior scientific state remains.

terms.plain_meaning: A value was not usable, so the step was discarded.
terms.scientific_meaning: Non-finite close/volume/event_time, unaligned IntervalStart, or H/C domain checks.
terms.interpretation: A value was not usable, so the step was discarded.

ui.popover_body: The host or engine rejected non-finite or unaligned input without committing state.

terms.plain_meaning: The scientific step failed. State was not updated.
terms.scientific_meaning: D01/D02/D04 error or pricing prepare failure rolled back as SkipEngineError.
terms.interpretation: The scientific step failed. State was not updated.

ui.popover_body: An engine error skips the minute and does not mutate committed history.

terms.plain_meaning: This symbol's worker panicked and was isolated. Other symbols continue.
terms.scientific_meaning: Host.handle recover marks SkipEnginePanic and discontinuous for that symbol only.
terms.interpretation: This symbol's worker panicked and was isolated. Other symbols continue.

ui.tooltip: This symbol panicked and was isolated.
ui.popover_body: Panic is contained per symbol. Other workers keep running.

terms.plain_meaning: This symbol is quarantined after proven loss. Later bars do not silently repair science.
terms.scientific_meaning: After markDisc, later bars emit SkipStateDiscontinuous with the original reason in Detail. Reserved for overflow, panic, or proven INPUT_GAP — not irregular IEX spacing.
does_not_mean: A skipped provider minute does not by itself create this state.
terms.interpretation: This symbol is quarantined after proven loss. Later bars do not silently repair science.

ui.popover_body: Later bars stay skipped until explicit per-symbol reset or process restart. Irregular IEX minutes are not this state.

terms.plain_meaning: Price Engine policy color GREEN for this minute's EXPM cover.
terms.scientific_meaning: EmissionPolicy.emit sets raw GREEN when phase is UP_ACCELERATING or TURNING_UP and ProjectedP1 > epsilon, unless confidence is LOW or a decelerating/near-stationary/uncertain phase forced AMBER. Direct GREEN↔RED reversals debounce to AMBER first.
does_not_mean: GREEN is not an execution command.
Viewer Arrivals ON TIME is a display alias of GREEN.
terms.interpretation: Price Engine policy color GREEN for this minute's EXPM cover.

ui.tooltip: Price Engine color GREEN. Not a BUY.
ui.popover_body: GREEN is a policy color on the EXPM trajectory. The Arrivals board shows it as ON TIME. It does not confirm Adaptive BUY.

terms.plain_meaning: Price Engine policy color AMBER: caution / holding color, not Adaptive HOLD.
terms.scientific_meaning: Raw AMBER when confidence is LOW or phase is UP_DECELERATING, DOWN_DECELERATING, NEAR_STATIONARY, or UNCERTAIN, or during direct-reversal debounce.
does_not_mean: Viewer Arrivals HOLDING is a display alias of AMBER.
terms.interpretation: Price Engine policy color AMBER: caution / holding color, not Adaptive HOLD.

ui.tooltip: Price Engine color AMBER. Not Adaptive HOLD.
ui.popover_body: AMBER is the caution color. The Arrivals board labels it HOLDING. That word is not the Adaptive HOLD decision.

terms.plain_meaning: Price Engine policy color RED for this minute's EXPM cover.
terms.scientific_meaning: Raw RED when phase is DOWN_ACCELERATING or TURNING_DOWN and ProjectedP1 < -epsilon, subject to LOW-confidence AMBER override and reversal debounce.
does_not_mean: Viewer Arrivals DELAYED is a display alias of RED.
terms.interpretation: Price Engine policy color RED for this minute's EXPM cover.

ui.tooltip: Price Engine color RED. Not a SELL.
ui.popover_body: RED is a policy color. The Arrivals board shows it as DELAYED. It does not confirm Adaptive SELL.

terms.plain_meaning: Price emission is invalid this minute (projection failed or non-finite).
terms.scientific_meaning: emit() returns color INVALID when !RKSuccess or non-finite trajectory. Reasons RK_FAILURE or NONFINITE_TRAJECTORY.
terms.interpretation: Price emission is invalid this minute (projection failed or non-finite).

ui.tooltip: Price Engine color INVALID this minute.
ui.popover_body: Projection failed or values were non-finite. No valid GREEN/AMBER/RED.

terms.plain_meaning: Current velocity is up and acceleration is positive.
terms.scientific_meaning: phase(): p1 > 0 and p2 > 0 (and not the turning/near-zero branches). p1 is causal-quadratic velocity; p2 is acceleration.
terms.interpretation: Current velocity is up and acceleration is positive.

ui.popover_body: p1 > 0 and p2 > 0 on the causal quadratic. Color still depends on confidence and projected p1.

terms.plain_meaning: Current velocity is down and acceleration is more down.
terms.scientific_meaning: phase() default when p1 <= 0 and p2 <= 0 after turning checks.
terms.interpretation: Current velocity is down and acceleration is more down.

ui.popover_body: Velocity is down and p2 is not lifting it. Not a SELL.

terms.plain_meaning: Velocity is still up, but acceleration is no longer supporting it.
terms.scientific_meaning: phase(): p1 > 0 and p2 <= 0.
does_not_mean: This phase forces raw color AMBER.
terms.interpretation: Velocity is still up, but acceleration is no longer supporting it.

ui.popover_body: Still moving up, but p2 is not positive. Policy paints AMBER.

terms.plain_meaning: Velocity is down, but acceleration is opposing the decline.
terms.scientific_meaning: phase(): p1 <= 0 and p2 > 0.
does_not_mean: This phase forces raw color AMBER.
terms.interpretation: Velocity is down, but acceleration is opposing the decline.

ui.popover_body: Decline is losing acceleration. Policy paints AMBER.

terms.plain_meaning: Velocity is near zero or crossing, with projected velocity up.
terms.scientific_meaning: phase(): |p1|<=eps and projectedP1>eps, or p1< -eps and projectedP1>=eps.
terms.interpretation: Velocity is near zero or crossing, with projected velocity up.

ui.popover_body: Projected p1 has crossed toward up. Not an Adaptive BUY.

terms.plain_meaning: Velocity is near zero or crossing, with projected velocity down.
terms.scientific_meaning: phase(): |p1|<=eps and projectedP1< -eps, or p1>eps and projectedP1<= -eps.
terms.interpretation: Velocity is near zero or crossing, with projected velocity down.

ui.popover_body: Projected p1 has crossed toward down. Not an Adaptive SELL.

terms.plain_meaning: Velocity is within epsilon and the projected velocity is also near zero.
terms.scientific_meaning: phase(): |p1|<=eps and |projectedP1|<=eps. Forces raw AMBER.
terms.interpretation: Velocity is within epsilon and the projected velocity is also near zero.

ui.popover_body: Both current and projected p1 sit inside the policy epsilon.

terms.plain_meaning: Price Engine numerical confidence is HIGH.
terms.scientific_meaning: IN_DOMAIN and condition, max Re(λ), and amplification are all <= configured medians.
terms.interpretation: Price Engine numerical confidence is HIGH.

ui.popover_body: Numerical condition, eigenvalue, and amplification sit at or below policy medians and the cover is in-domain.

terms.plain_meaning: Price Engine numerical confidence is MEDIUM.
terms.scientific_meaning: IN_DOMAIN and the three numerical measures sit between medians and q95.
terms.interpretation: Price Engine numerical confidence is MEDIUM.

ui.popover_body: Numerical measures are above medians but still within q95.

terms.plain_meaning: Price Engine numerical confidence is LOW. Forces AMBER.
terms.scientific_meaning: OUT_OF_DOMAIN or any of condition/eigenvalue/amplification exceeds q95. Reasons DOMAIN_EXIT and/or LOW_CONFIDENCE.
does_not_mean: LOW · domain exit is two fields, not one fused decision.
terms.interpretation: Price Engine numerical confidence is LOW. Forces AMBER.

ui.popover_body: Either the cover left the fit domain or numerical measures exceeded q95. Combined dashboard text LOW · domain exit is two independent fields.

terms.plain_meaning: The projected cover stayed inside the F4 window envelope.
terms.scientific_meaning: DomainState IN_DOMAIN when numericalRow.DomainExit is false.
terms.interpretation: The projected cover stayed inside the F4 window envelope.

ui.tooltip: EXPM cover stayed in the F4 envelope.
ui.popover_body: No envelope exit on the one-minute projection.

terms.plain_meaning: The projected cover left the F4 window min/max envelope.
terms.scientific_meaning: DomainState OUT_OF_DOMAIN when DomainExit is true. Adds reason DOMAIN_EXIT and forces LOW confidence.
terms.interpretation: The projected cover left the F4 window min/max envelope.

ui.tooltip: EXPM cover left the F4 envelope.
ui.popover_body: Domain exit is a pricing envelope fact. It is not a SELL.

terms.plain_meaning: The one-minute cover exited the fitted price/p1/p2 envelope.
terms.scientific_meaning: PriceEvent.DomainExit and reason code DOMAIN_EXIT when the EXPM trajectory leaves stored window min/max. Viewer remarks append 'domain exit'.
does_not_mean: Domain exit does not by itself mean SELL.
terms.interpretation: The one-minute cover exited the fitted price/p1/p2 envelope.

ui.tooltip: Cover left the F4 envelope. Not a SELL.
ui.popover_body: The projection stepped outside the window used to fit F4. Combined with LOW confidence this is still not an Adaptive decision.

terms.plain_meaning: Companion-matrix max real eigenvalue is <= 0.
terms.scientific_meaning: stability STABLE when MaxRealEigenvalue <= 0.
terms.interpretation: Companion-matrix max real eigenvalue is <= 0.

ui.popover_body: max Re(λ) of the 3×3 companion is <= 0.

terms.plain_meaning: The local linearization has a positive real eigenvalue.
terms.scientific_meaning: STABLE vs LOCALLY_EXPANSIVE: MaxRealEigenvalue > 0 adds POSITIVE_MAX_REAL_EIGENVALUE.
terms.interpretation: The local linearization has a positive real eigenvalue.

ui.tooltip: Local linearization is expansive (positive Re λ).
ui.popover_body: The 3×3 companion has max Re(λ) > 0.

terms.plain_meaning: Price Engine is still filling the 15-point derivative window.
terms.scientific_meaning: PricingStatus WARMUP_DERIVATIVE when p1/p2 are not yet finite. Viewer treats this as minute N of 45 boarding.
does_not_mean: Not Adaptive INITIALIZING (that is 15 bars to a decision).
terms.interpretation: Price Engine is still filling the 15-point derivative window.

ui.popover_body: Causal quadratic is not ready. Adaptive may already be ACTIONABLE.

terms.plain_meaning: Derivatives exist, but the 30-point F4 window is not ready.
terms.scientific_meaning: PricingStatus WARMUP_F4. Together with derivative warm-up, first emission is after 45 accepted minutes on the fixture.
terms.interpretation: Derivatives exist, but the 30-point F4 window is not ready.

ui.popover_body: Need more accepted minutes before a color. Fixture counts: 15 derivative + 30 F4 + 55 emitted.

terms.plain_meaning: F4 could not be fit at the active index.
terms.scientific_meaning: fit_f4_at_index returned none (scales, finite checks, or newest-index reject).
terms.interpretation: F4 could not be fit at the active index.

ui.popover_body: No physical affine coefficients, so no cover.

terms.plain_meaning: PriceEngine produced a PriceEmission this minute.
terms.scientific_meaning: PricingStatus EMITTED after numerical row + observe. Fixture count 55/100.
terms.interpretation: PriceEngine produced a PriceEmission this minute.

ui.tooltip: Price Engine emitted a color/phase this minute.
ui.popover_body: A PriceEmission exists. Color is still not an Adaptive decision.

terms.plain_meaning: The EXPM cover did not succeed. Color is invalid.
terms.scientific_meaning: Canonical current status is PROJECTION_FAILURE. Go production solver is EXPM (time_term false). Proto enum is PRICING_STATUS_PROJECTION_FAILURE. Frozen SADE Pricing Unit Run 001 still stores the CSV string RK45_FAILURE; domain.PricingStatusProjectionFailure keeps that string only so fixture status compares. Field rk_success means projection succeeded, not that RK45 ran.
does_not_mean: Go production did not run RK45.
rk_success false is not permission to port RK45.
terms.interpretation: The EXPM cover did not succeed. Color is invalid.

ui.tooltip: Projection failed. Production solver is EXPM.
ui.popover_body: The cover did not succeed, so color is invalid this minute. Historical SADE CSV used the name RK45_FAILURE. QuanTRAM Go does not execute RK45.

terms.plain_meaning: Pricing skip: cover failed.
terms.scientific_meaning: PricingSkipReason PROJECTION_FAILURE. Same failure family as PRICE_STATUS_PROJECTION_FAILURE. Historical SADE status string RK45_FAILURE is a fixture alias only.
terms.interpretation: Pricing skip: cover failed.

ui.popover_body: Typed pricing skip when the cover cannot be packaged.

terms.plain_meaning: This bar is exactly one minute after the last accepted bar.
terms.scientific_meaning: ClassifyBarContinuity returns ContinuityNormal when elapsed == time.Minute.
does_not_mean: Normal spacing is not required for scientific continuity.
terms.interpretation: This bar is exactly one minute after the last accepted bar.

ui.tooltip: Exactly one minute after the last accepted bar.
ui.popover_body: Usual IEX cadence. Irregular cadence can also be valid.

terms.plain_meaning: This bar is later than the last accepted bar by more than one minute, with no proven loss.
terms.scientific_meaning: ContinuityIrregular when elapsed is a positive multiple of one minute other than exactly one minute. Host accepts and logs; D01 uses actual dt; P-04 uses actual minutes.
terms.interpretation: This bar is later than the last accepted bar by more than one minute, with no proven loss.

ui.tooltip: Valid skipped-minute interval. Not a gap latch.
ui.popover_body: Example: 10:31 then 10:34 with no 10:33 provider bar. Science continues with the real elapsed time.

terms.plain_meaning: Same IntervalStart as the last accepted bar.
terms.scientific_meaning: ContinuityDuplicate when elapsed == 0.
terms.interpretation: Same IntervalStart as the last accepted bar.

ui.popover_body: Idempotent reject. No second Step.

terms.plain_meaning: This bar's IntervalStart is earlier than the last accepted bar.
terms.scientific_meaning: ContinuityRegression when elapsed < 0.
terms.interpretation: This bar's IntervalStart is earlier than the last accepted bar.

ui.popover_body: Rejected. Scientific state is not walked backward.

terms.plain_meaning: Host health for this symbol is discontinuous.
terms.scientific_meaning: SymbolStatus discontinuous after markDisc. GetHealth model/pricing detail may be discontinuous.
terms.interpretation: Host health for this symbol is discontinuous.

ui.popover_body: Health-level quarantine after proven loss.

terms.plain_meaning: Infer is off after this symbol has already accepted bars.
terms.scientific_meaning: SymbolHealth StatusPaused when infer is false and hasAccepted.
terms.interpretation: Infer is off after this symbol has already accepted bars.

ui.tooltip: Host paused on infer-off. State held.
ui.popover_body: Evaluation is paused globally or for readiness. History remains.

terms.plain_meaning: This 1-minute bar is finalized and complete.
terms.scientific_meaning: QualityComplete on live T=b bars. Required for ModelEligible.
terms.interpretation: This 1-minute bar is finalized and complete.

ui.popover_body: Eligible for Adaptive and Price Engine if not backfilled.

terms.plain_meaning: Forming minute (Alpaca u). Observe-only.
terms.scientific_meaning: QualityPartial, IsFinal false. Model path ignores it.
terms.interpretation: Forming minute (Alpaca u). Observe-only.

ui.popover_body: Live Market Bar Data may show it. The model does not.

terms.plain_meaning: REST/gap-fill bar. Observe-only. Never Adaptive or Price Engine input.
terms.scientific_meaning: QualityReconstructed and IsBackfilled. ModelEligible is false.
does_not_mean: Not a synthetic flat bar invented by QuanTRAM science.
terms.interpretation: REST/gap-fill bar. Observe-only. Never Adaptive or Price Engine input.

ui.tooltip: Gap-fill bar. Not a model input.
ui.popover_body: REST history may fill the chart. P-03/P-04 do not consume it.

terms.plain_meaning: Quality label STALE exists on Bar. Live freshness is a separate 90s watermark.
terms.scientific_meaning: RESERVED. QualityStale is defined on domain.QualityStatus and mapped by toProtoQuality. classifyAlpacaBar writes only QualityReconstructed (backfilled), QualityPartial (forming), or QualityComplete (final live). csv_source writes QualityComplete. No production writer assigns QualityStale. InferReady freshness uses LiveFresh (MaxFinalLateness 90s after IntervalEnd) and does not write this enum. Tests never construct QualityStale.
does_not_mean: STALE quality is not automatically INPUT_GAP.
terms.interpretation: Quality label STALE exists on Bar. Live freshness is a separate 90s watermark.

ui.tooltip: Reserved bar-quality enum STALE. Not written on the live Alpaca path.
ui.popover_body: Freshness uses a 90s LiveFresh watermark. That gate does not assign this enum.

terms.plain_meaning: P-02 quality gate that allows the model host to evaluate.
terms.scientific_meaning: Readiness.Infer from InferReady: two causally ordered finalized bars, last ModelEligible and LiveFresh, feed HEALTHY.
does_not_mean: Infer false does not reset science.
terms.interpretation: P-02 quality gate that allows the model host to evaluate.

ui.popover_body: When infer is false the host emits INFER_OFF and holds state.

terms.plain_meaning: The feed is observable for the dashboard chart.
terms.scientific_meaning: Readiness.Observe is true when the breaker is healthy, degraded, or recovering.
does_not_mean: Observe healthy does not mean Adaptive is running.
terms.interpretation: The feed is observable for the dashboard chart.

ui.popover_body: The candle page can be healthy while Adaptive is off or initializing.

terms.plain_meaning: Market feed breaker is healthy.
terms.scientific_meaning: FeedState HEALTHY.
does_not_mean: Not proof that Adaptive is ACTIONABLE.
terms.interpretation: Market feed breaker is healthy.

ui.popover_body: Socket/heartbeats look healthy. Model state is separate.

terms.plain_meaning: Feed is up but degraded.
terms.scientific_meaning: FeedState DEGRADED.
terms.interpretation: Feed is up but degraded.

ui.popover_body: Observation may continue. Infer can be gated.

terms.plain_meaning: Feed breaker failed.
terms.scientific_meaning: FeedState FAILED.
terms.interpretation: Feed breaker failed.

ui.popover_body: Live bars are not reliable.

terms.plain_meaning: Feed is recovering after a problem.
terms.scientific_meaning: FeedState RECOVERING. Distinct from ContinuityIrregular.
terms.interpretation: Feed is recovering after a problem.

ui.popover_body: A feed-level recovery state, not a Price Engine turning tendency.

terms.plain_meaning: Airport-board alias for Adaptive INITIALIZING.
terms.scientific_meaning: quantram-dashboard adaptiveFlight maps skipReason INITIALIZING to status BOARDING. Not a Go enum.
does_not_mean: Not Price Engine boarding (that is pricing warm-up).
terms.interpretation: Airport-board alias for Adaptive INITIALIZING.

ui.popover_body: Departures BOARDING means Adaptive INITIALIZING, minutes 1–15.

terms.plain_meaning: Airport-board alias for Adaptive BUY or SELL.
terms.scientific_meaning: adaptiveFlight sets CLEARED when kind is decision and side is not HOLD.
terms.interpretation: Airport-board alias for Adaptive BUY or SELL.

ui.tooltip: Viewer word for Adaptive BUY or SELL.
ui.popover_body: Departures CLEARED is a flight-board skin over BUY or SELL.

terms.plain_meaning: Airport-board alias for Adaptive HOLD. Not Price Engine HOLDING.
terms.scientific_meaning: adaptiveFlight sets HOLDING when Decision.side is HOLD.
terms.interpretation: Airport-board alias for Adaptive HOLD. Not Price Engine HOLDING.

ui.popover_body: Same English as Arrivals HOLDING, different science. This one is Adaptive HOLD.

terms.plain_meaning: Airport-board alias for Adaptive INFER_OFF or TIMEOUT.
terms.scientific_meaning: adaptiveFlight DELAYED for INFER_OFF or TIMEOUT.
terms.interpretation: Airport-board alias for Adaptive INFER_OFF or TIMEOUT.

ui.tooltip: Departures DELAYED means infer-off or timeout.
ui.popover_body: Not Arrivals DELAYED, which means Price Engine RED.

terms.plain_meaning: Airport-board alias for Adaptive INPUT_GAP, QUEUE_OVERFLOW, or STATE_DISCONTINUOUS.
terms.scientific_meaning: adaptiveFlight GROUNDED for those skip reasons.
does_not_mean: A valid irregular IEX minute should not appear here after the continuity fix.
terms.interpretation: Airport-board alias for Adaptive INPUT_GAP, QUEUE_OVERFLOW, or STATE_DISCONTINUOUS.

ui.popover_body: Reserved for overflow, proven gap, or discontinuous latch — not a normal skipped IEX minute.

terms.plain_meaning: Airport-board alias for other Adaptive skips.
terms.scientific_meaning: adaptiveFlight default status DIVERTED.
terms.interpretation: Airport-board alias for other Adaptive skips.

ui.tooltip: Departures DIVERTED means another Adaptive skip.
ui.popover_body: Catch-all flight status for skips that are not boarding, cleared, holding, delayed, or grounded.

terms.plain_meaning: Airport-board alias for Price Engine GREEN.
terms.scientific_meaning: pricingFlight maps color GREEN to ON TIME. Not a Go enum.
does_not_mean: Not a schedule or fill-quality metric.
terms.interpretation: Airport-board alias for Price Engine GREEN.

ui.tooltip: Arrivals ON TIME means Price Engine GREEN.
ui.popover_body: Viewer skin only. The server field is Color GREEN.

terms.plain_meaning: Airport-board alias for Price Engine AMBER. Not Adaptive HOLD.
terms.scientific_meaning: pricingFlight maps color AMBER to HOLDING.
terms.interpretation: Airport-board alias for Price Engine AMBER. Not Adaptive HOLD.

ui.tooltip: Arrivals HOLDING means Price Engine AMBER, not Adaptive HOLD.
ui.popover_body: This is the most collision-prone English word in the viewer. Adaptive HOLD is a different field.

terms.plain_meaning: Airport-board alias for Price Engine RED.
terms.scientific_meaning: pricingFlight maps color RED to DELAYED.
terms.interpretation: Airport-board alias for Price Engine RED.

ui.tooltip: Arrivals DELAYED means Price Engine RED.
ui.popover_body: Not Departures DELAYED. Not a SELL.

terms.plain_meaning: Airport-board alias for Price Engine warm-up (minutes 1–45).
terms.scientific_meaning: pricingFlight BOARDING when status is WARMUP_DERIVATIVE, WARMUP_F4, or F4_FIT_UNAVAILABLE.
terms.interpretation: Airport-board alias for Price Engine warm-up (minutes 1–45).

ui.tooltip: Arrivals BOARDING means Price Engine warm-up.
ui.popover_body: Warm-up through minute 45. Adaptive boarding is only 15.

terms.plain_meaning: Airport-board alias for Price Engine INVALID or unknown color.
terms.scientific_meaning: pricingFlight DIVERTED when color is not GREEN/AMBER/RED.
terms.interpretation: Airport-board alias for Price Engine INVALID or unknown color.

ui.tooltip: Arrivals DIVERTED means invalid/unknown price color.
ui.popover_body: Usually INVALID projection. Not Adaptive DIVERTED.

terms.plain_meaning: Signed velocity is above policy epsilon.
terms.scientific_meaning: direction(p1, epsilon) returns UP when value > epsilon.
terms.interpretation: Signed velocity is above policy epsilon.

ui.popover_body: Signed p1 classification. Independent of Adaptive path.

terms.plain_meaning: Signed velocity is below −epsilon.
terms.scientific_meaning: direction() returns DOWN when value < -epsilon.
terms.interpretation: Signed velocity is below −epsilon.

ui.popover_body: Signed p1 classification. Not a SELL.

terms.plain_meaning: Signed velocity is inside ±epsilon.
terms.scientific_meaning: direction() returns NEAR_ZERO otherwise.
terms.interpretation: Signed velocity is inside ±epsilon.

ui.popover_body: p1 is inside the frozen policy epsilon.

terms.plain_meaning: Cockpit interpreter persistence of opposing deceleration.
terms.scientific_meaning: PriceCockpit.PersistenceState NONE or UP/DOWN_DECELERATION from opposingDir counts. Not D01 persistence.
terms.interpretation: Cockpit interpreter persistence of opposing deceleration.

ui.tooltip: Price cockpit persistence, not D01 persistence.
ui.popover_body: Counts opposing deceleration observations. Different from Adaptive persistence.

terms.plain_meaning: No additional turning-tendency label beyond the phase.
terms.scientific_meaning: turningTendency returns NONE when no cross/deteriorate/recover/p2-reversal rule hits.
terms.interpretation: No additional turning-tendency label beyond the phase.

ui.popover_body: Phase still exists. Tendency is NONE.

terms.plain_meaning: Turning-tendency flag: current p1 is down and projected p1 is up.
terms.scientific_meaning: turningTendency: p1 < -epsilon && projectedP1 >= epsilon. Same English as PRICE_PHASE_TURNING_UP but a different function and field (turning_tendency, not trajectory_phase).
does_not_mean: Not the same object as PRICE_PHASE_TURNING_UP.
terms.interpretation: Turning-tendency flag: current p1 is down and projected p1 is up.

ui.tooltip: Tendency TURNING_UP — not the phase field.
ui.popover_body: A separate PriceEmission field from trajectory_phase. Both can display TURNING UP.

terms.plain_meaning: Turning-tendency flag: current p1 is up and projected p1 is down.
terms.scientific_meaning: turningTendency: p1 > epsilon && projectedP1 <= -epsilon. Distinct from PRICE_PHASE_TURNING_DOWN.
does_not_mean: Not the same object as PRICE_PHASE_TURNING_DOWN.
terms.interpretation: Turning-tendency flag: current p1 is up and projected p1 is down.

ui.tooltip: Tendency TURNING_DOWN — not the phase field.
ui.popover_body: A separate field from trajectory_phase.

terms.plain_meaning: Upward velocity is already decelerating and projected p1 is weaker than current p1.
terms.scientific_meaning: turningTendency: p1 > epsilon && p2 < 0 && projectedP1 < p1.
terms.interpretation: Upward velocity is already decelerating and projected p1 is weaker than current p1.

ui.popover_body: Not an execution instruction.

terms.plain_meaning: Downward velocity is already decelerating and projected p1 is less negative than current p1.
terms.scientific_meaning: turningTendency: p1 < -epsilon && p2 > 0 && projectedP1 > p1.
terms.interpretation: Downward velocity is already decelerating and projected p1 is less negative than current p1.

ui.tooltip: Price tendency recovering toward turn — not feed recovery.
ui.popover_body: A Price Engine turning_tendency. Feed RECOVERING is a different enum.

terms.plain_meaning: Current and projected curvature have opposite signs.
terms.scientific_meaning: turningTendency: p2 * projectedP2 < 0.
terms.interpretation: Current and projected curvature have opposite signs.

ui.popover_body: Not the Adaptive reversal measure.

terms.plain_meaning: Go production pricing refuses time_term true. EXPM only.
terms.scientific_meaning: projection.solve_cover / mapper returns ANALYTIC_TIME_TERM_UNSUPPORTED when time_term is true. PricingSkipReason TIME_TERM.
terms.interpretation: Go production pricing refuses time_term true. EXPM only.

ui.popover_body: Go production pricing is EXPM. RK45 is not on the live path.

terms.plain_meaning: The EXPM cover was rejected as numerically unstable.
terms.scientific_meaning: projection returns Unstable true with NUMERICALLY_UNSTABLE. PricingSkipReason NUMERICALLY_UNSTABLE.
terms.interpretation: The EXPM cover was rejected as numerically unstable.

ui.popover_body: No valid color this minute.

terms.plain_meaning: Arrivals-board alias for Price Engine AMBER.
terms.scientific_meaning: quantram-dashboard pricingFlight maps color AMBER to status HOLDING. Not a Price Engine enum. Canonical viewer twin of VIEWER_PRICE_HOLDING.
does_not_mean: This does not mean the Adaptive Emitter decision HOLD.
This is not independently a BUY or SELL instruction.
This is not a Price Engine phase named HOLDING.
terms.interpretation: Arrivals-board alias for Price Engine AMBER.

ui.tooltip: Price trajectory is currently in a holding phase relative to its projected progression.
ui.popover_body: Airport-board label for AMBER. Independent of Adaptive HOLD. Not an order.

terms.plain_meaning: Arrivals-board alias for Price Engine GREEN.
terms.scientific_meaning: pricingFlight maps color GREEN to status ON TIME. Not a Price Engine enum.
does_not_mean: ON TIME is not a BUY.
terms.interpretation: Arrivals-board alias for Price Engine GREEN.

ui.popover_body: Viewer label only. GREEN is the scientific color.

terms.plain_meaning: Arrivals-board alias for Price Engine RED.
terms.scientific_meaning: pricingFlight maps color RED to status DELAYED. Distinct from VIEWER_ADAPTIVE_DELAYED (infer-off / timeout).
terms.interpretation: Arrivals-board alias for Price Engine RED.

ui.tooltip: Arrivals alias for RED — not Adaptive DELAYED.
ui.popover_body: Viewer label for RED. Adaptive DELAYED means infer-off or timeout.

terms.plain_meaning: Adaptive evolving-state model (kinematics, channels, half-life).
terms.scientific_meaning: internal/adaptive D01V02Model.Step. EventTime is IntervalStart unix seconds. dt is actual elapsed seconds.
does_not_mean: D01 is not the Price Engine.
terms.interpretation: Adaptive evolving-state model (kinematics, channels, half-life).

ui.popover_body: Recursive state model stepped on each accepted eligible bar.

terms.plain_meaning: Elastic return shape built from D01 outputs.
terms.scientific_meaning: BuildReturnShape(dmo, fmo) → ReturnShape including PathDirection and channel scalars.
does_not_mean: D02 is not an order envelope.
terms.interpretation: Elastic return shape built from D01 outputs.

ui.popover_body: Shape, path, and channel scores used by D04.

terms.plain_meaning: Trading envelope: H, Q_G, Q_S, Q_R, and capturability C.
terms.scientific_meaning: EvaluateCapturability(shape, ProductionContext(event_time)).
terms.interpretation: Trading envelope: H, Q_G, Q_S, Q_R, and capturability C.

ui.popover_body: Produces H and C used by the emitter. Not OMS risk.

terms.plain_meaning: The Adaptive decision stage that emits BUY, SELL, or HOLD.
terms.scientific_meaning: AdaptiveEngine decide() plus emitter position state.
terms.interpretation: The Adaptive decision stage that emits BUY, SELL, or HOLD.

ui.tooltip: Adaptive Emitter: BUY, SELL, or HOLD.
ui.popover_body: Sibling of Price Engine on the same accepted bar. They do not consume each other.

terms.plain_meaning: Collocated EXPM pricing engine that emits color, phase, and confidence.
terms.scientific_meaning: internal/pricing PricingEngine on the same accepted eligible bar as Adaptive. time_term false only. Does not emit BUY/SELL/HOLD.
does_not_mean: Not a confirmation of Adaptive BUY/SELL.
terms.interpretation: Collocated EXPM pricing engine that emits color, phase, and confidence.

ui.tooltip: Price Engine: EXPM color, not a buy or sell.
ui.popover_body: Sibling science on the same accepted bar. GREEN/AMBER/RED are not Adaptive decisions.

does_not_mean: Not a live-path quality label today.
